text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain wins eight awards at a television festival in Egypt.
- Britain's Cable and Wireless opens a regional office in Bahrain.
- About 1,000 new homes, at a cost of 24 million dinars, will be made available for Bahraini families by 1999, an official says.
- Bahrain could benefit at several levels from South Korea's experience in the field of small and medium industry growth, a government official says.
- Emir says Bahrain looks forward to boosting cooperation with the United States.
- Two fires destroy shops in Isa Town on Saturday.
